rv.q: Fish demands almost as much from the people in the audience as he does from his cast, forcing them to really listen for lines delivered in near whispers.

Fish and his cast ask reasoned questions of a musical that has contained all these questions in plain sight for many years-and in this Oklahoma! those questions are answered with vivid, pugnacious confidence.
As with many a reimagining of a classic, not all of Fish's gambits entirely work.
All things considered, there should also be a giant question mark.
